name: 数据报告
description: 从一张销售表做出数据报告：你提供表格 → 脚本画像（类型、缺失、唯一值、最小/最大/平均/中位数、日期范围）→ 模型只写图表规格（柱状、折线或表格，不写代码）→ 脚本汇总并手写 SVG → 模型先写结论再引用图 → 脚本合成报告，并核对正文里的每个数字都能在画像或汇总里找到。 / Turn a sales table into a data report: you provide the table → a script profiles each column → the model writes a chart spec only (bar, line or table, never code) → a script aggregates and draws SVG by hand → the model leads with the answer and cites each chart → a script assembles the report and checks that every number in the text appears in the profile or the aggregates.

question.description: 要回答的问题，例如：哪个类目和地区的销售额最高，下一步该补货还是促销？ / The question to answer

audience.description: 谁来读这份报告，例如：区域销售经理 / Who will read the report

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 表格
stages.description: 放上要分析的 CSV。示例 data/sales.csv 是虚构的一个季度销售，约 200 行，列是 date、category、region、amount、quantity，有少量空值。 / The CSV to analyse. The sample data/sales.csv is a fictional quarter of sales, about 200 rows, with date, category, region, amount and quantity, and a few empty cells.

executor.instructions: 把你的表保存为 data/sales.csv，表头用 date,category,region,amount,quantity。示例是虚构数据，空着的格子不用补。 / Save your table as data/sales.csv with the header date,category,region,amount,quantity. The sample is fictional; leave empty cells empty.

stages.name: 画像
stages.description: 按列写出类型、缺失个数、唯一值个数、最小/最大/平均/中位数，以及日期范围。缺失值只计数，不填补。 / For each column: type, missing count, distinct count, min, max, mean and median, plus the date range. Missing values are counted and not filled in.

stages.name: 图表规格
stages.description: 模型只写 charts.json：每张图是 bar、line 或 table，带 x、y、汇总方式和筛选。不写代码，不算新的总数。 / The model writes charts.json only: each chart is a bar, line or table, with x, y, an aggregation and a filter. No code, and no new totals.

stages.name: 出图
stages.description: 按规格汇总，手写 charts/*.svg（浅色和深色都能看清）和 aggregates.json。柱状图按数值从高到低、从 0 起算；折线按时间排列并带点；表格写出精确值。 / Aggregate the spec into hand-written charts/*.svg (readable in light and dark) and aggregates.json. Bars are sorted and start at 0; lines follow time and mark each point; tables print the exact values.

stages.name: 分析
stages.description: 先用一句话回答问题，再写发生了什么、可能的原因和建议。每个发现都引用一张图，数字只从 profile.json 和 aggregates.json 原样抄。 / Answer the question in one sentence, then what happened, a possible reason, and what to do. Every finding cites a chart. Copy numbers from profile.json and aggregates.json; do not compute new ones.

stages.name: 报告
stages.description: 合成 report.md 和自包含的 report.html。正文里对不上画像或汇总的数字、没被引用的图、没有把结论放在开头，都写进 check-report.md，只提醒不拦截。 / Assemble report.md and a self-contained report.html. Numbers missing from the profile or the aggregates, uncited charts, and an analysis that does not lead with the answer go in check-report.md. Those checks warn and do not block.
